title: Flashcards or blank cards
subject: PSHE
source: Written for pshe/y10 lesson 17 (Flashcards or blank cards)
intro: Lesson 17: Resilience and revision habits for Year 11. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

blocks.task: write a key word on one side and its meaning on the other.

keywords.def: trusting Allah after doing your best

questions.q: Turn 'read chapter 3' into a retrieval task.
questions.a: Close the book, write everything you remember, then check and fix gaps.

questions.q: Pupil PDF: a weekly revision timetable for Year 11 with salah, rest and retrieval tasks.
questions.a: A realistic timetable with rest and worship.

questions.q: Extend: make five flashcards for one subject tonight.

options: revising little and often over time
questions.a: A) revising little and often over time. Spread it out.

questions.q: Think again: Two pupils revise for 10 hours. One rereads notes; one tests herself. Who remembers more?
questions.a: Usually the one who tests herself: retrieval practice strengthens memory.
